H6100.gloss: Etsjon-Geber, a place on the Red Sea

H6101.gloss: to lean idly, i.e. to be indolent or slack

H6105.gloss: to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones
H6105.definition:
a primitive root; also denominatively (from H6106 (עֶצֶם))
to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones
KJV: break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty(-ier), be more, shut, be(-come, make) strong(-er).

H6106.gloss: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame

H6113.gloss: to inclose; by analogy, to hold back; also to maintain, rule, assemble

H6116.gloss: an assembly, especially on afestival or holiday

H6117.gloss: to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)
H6117.definition:
a primitive root; properly, to swell out or up; used only as denominative from H6119 (עָקֵב),
to seize by the heel; figuratively, to circumvent (as if tripping up the heels); also to restrain (as if holding by the heel)
KJV: take by the heel, stay, supplant, [idiom] utterly.

H6118.gloss: a heel, i.e. (figuratively) the last of anything (used adverbially, for ever); also result, i.e. compensation; and so (adverb with preposition or relatively) on account of

H6119.gloss: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)

H6121.definition:
from H6117 (עָקַב); in the original sense, a knoll (as swelling up); in the denominative sense
(transitive) fraudulent or (intransitive) tracked
KJV: crooked, deceitful, polluted.

H6126.gloss: Akkub, the name of five Israelites

H6131.gloss: to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate

H6132.gloss: {to pluck up (especially by the roots); specifically, to hamstring; figuratively, to exterminate}

H6133.gloss: figuratively, a transplanted person, i.e. naturalized citizen

H6135.gloss: sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs)

H6137.gloss: a scorpion; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip

H6139.gloss: an Ekronite or inhabitant of Ekron

H6140.gloss: to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)

H6147.gloss: Er, the name of two Israelites

H6148.gloss: to braid, i.e. intermix; technically, to traffic (as if by barter); also or give to be security (as a kind of exchange)

H6152.gloss: Arab (i.e. Arabia), a country East of Palestine

H6154.gloss: the web (or transverse threads of cloth); also a mixture, (or mongrel race)

H6155.gloss: a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles)

H6159.gloss: Oreb, the name of a Midianite and of the cliff near the Jordan

H6160.gloss: a desert; especially (with the article prefix) the (generally) sterile valley of the Jordan and its continuation to the Red Sea

H6161.gloss: something given as security, i.e. (literally) a token (of safety) or (metaphorically) a bondsman

H6163.gloss: an Arabian or inhabitant of Arab (i.e. Arabia)

H6164.gloss: an Arbathite or inhabitant of (Beth-) Arabah

H6166.gloss: Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite

H6168.gloss: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish

H6170.gloss: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre

H6172.gloss: nudity, literally (especially the pudenda) or figuratively (disgrace, blemish)

H6176.gloss: a juniper (from its nudity of situation)

H6177.gloss: Aroer, the name of three places in or near Palestine

H6178.gloss: feared, i.e. (concretely) a horrible place or chasm

H6180.gloss: a Erite (collectively) or descendants of Eri

H6183.gloss: the sky (as dropping at the horizon)

H6186.gloss: to set in a row, i.e. arrange, put in order (in a very wide variety of applications)

H6188.gloss: to expose or remove the prepuce, whether literal (to go naked) or figurative (to refrain from using)

H6189.gloss: uncircumcised (i.e. still having the prepuce uncurtailed)

H6191.gloss: properly, to be (or make) bare; but used only in the derivative sense (through the idea perhaps of smoothness) to be cunning (usually in a bad sense)

H6195.gloss: trickery; or (in a good sense) discretion

H6196.gloss: the plane tree (from its smooth and shed bark)

H6198.gloss: an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran
